items.Sentence: WDRs Order 82-068 regulates the discharge of the District’s WWTF and allows a discharge of up to 0.15 million gallons per day (mgd) to 20 acres of evaporation/percolation ponds.
The proposed upgrades to the WWTF include a new headworks, four facultative ponds, two storage ponds, and five evaporation/percolation ponds.
